question:
If Δ XYZ ≅ Δ LMR, then m + x + p = ____________.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66ae916125df05f9f40f91b1c853699e2a8155a7b36392b285ac70d42801026b.png]
solution:
Given:

Δ XYZ ≅ Δ LMR

Formula:

If Δ XYZ ≅ Δ LMR, then

XY/LM = YZ/MR = XZ/LR

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66ae916125df05f9f40f91b1c853699e2a8155a7b36392b285ac70d42801026b.png] 

XY/LM = YZ/MR = XZ/LR

2m + 1 = 5 ........(1)

2p + 2 = 8 ........(2)

2X - 1 = 7 ........(3)

Adding all 3 equations:

⇒ 2m + 2p + 2X + 2 = 20

⇒ 2m + 2p + 2x = 18

⇒ m + p + x = 9

**The value is 9**
